quote: Was für eine tolle Masterclass mit Jasmin Solfaghari und Helmut Kukuk! Ich bin hellauf begeistert. Eine positive, wertschätzende, aufbauende Stimmung, tolle Tipps und viele gute, begabte Kollegen!
author: Franka Kraneis

quote: Ich habe an der Meisterklasse 2023 der Oper Leipzig mit Jasmin Solfaghari und Helmut Kukuk teilgenommen und es war eine tolle Erfahrung. Die Arbeit an der Interpretation und Präsentation der Arien hat mir definitiv viel gegeben.
author: Iga Kowalczyk

quote: Ihr Kurs vom 8.–10. Juli 2017 in Torgau mit einer abschließenden, öffentlichen Präsentation wurde von allen Teilnehmern und auch vom Publikum mit Begeisterung aufgenommen.
author: Prof. Elvira Dressen

quote: I had the pleasure to sing in masterclasses directed by Jasmin Solfaghari. With total control over all aspects of the dramatic piece, full understanding of the text and sensitivity to the smallest details, Jasmin has built remarkable, original and very accurate operatic scenes.
author: Shira Bitan

quote: Jasmin Solfaghari is a wonderful teacher and director. I have worked with her both in a masterclass and on an opera production. Her knowledge in music and languages is remarkable, and I would highly recommend working with Ms. Solfaghari.
author: Nitzan Alon

quote: I just wanted to take another chance to say thank you for the fantastic masterclass today. Sharing your deep breadth of practical knowledge with budding singers and actors is a wonderful thing.
author: Dimitri Smith

quote: You are truly a master teacher.
author: Henry Price

quote: Your unique way of understanding and interpreting human situations in the opera scenes you directed during the workshop you gave was remarkable — your warmth, generosity, patience and kindness towards the students were outstanding.
author: Zvi Semel
source: The Jerusalem Academy for Music and Dance

quote: It was, in short, the finest Master Class I have ever witnessed in my teaching and performing career.
author: Donald Simonson
